reviews.text: Service is good when I bought my cat to check. Dr was nice and assistants but they don't really follow up and expect you to call them. Done test and costed us almost $800 just lab and vaccine and was told that my cat need dental gave us a quote for $3k. I was researching and thought there should be cheaper than $3k. Sure enough I found this animal hospital in Brookfield, took my cat 2 extraction with cleaning for $600+. Some animal clinic don't really care about your pet well being and just want to take your money so if you need dental go to Merrick hospital.
Very excellent service. Everyone is very polite, nice and helpful.
The care at VCA seems good for the most part. However, they will try to up charge and push unnecessary tests for your pet.

Experience was good, I went for free check up, got food and checkup for my puppy.   My only complaint is they mislead you to thinking somethings are included. Which they are not! I despise when they really try to push things onto you, like, you know if you're dog isn't fixed, it can cause cance4, or you need to pullnthe baby teeth, they haven't fallen out yet.  I mean, im here cause I wanna be, stop trying to scare me into a sell.  Also, you know by law you hafta get this shot, like geez

I didn’t have a good experience at this Vet. They didn’t call me with my cats tests results on Saturday even when they knew she tested positive for Giardia. By Sunday night my kitten was unresponsive and had to go to an emergency vet. She had a very high fever and almost didn’t make it. $4k later she is back home with me, thank goodness. Even on Monday I had to call them twice to talk to a vet to get the results. You are just a number to them. And Manny, the office receptionist was rude to me when I was rightfully upset about them not calling with the results. How could I not be upset when you just put them in your vet’s file to all ‘ when she gets back to work’?! That is crazy! Hand the results to the vet working that day or call yourself. I almost lost my kitten because of lack of attention to detail.

Dr. Moody and his assistant were really extremely helpful! My dog got bitten by tick and I was extremely worried. Dr. Moody  the entire VCA staff showed care for my dog and made sure he received the care he needed. We visited a few vet clinics in the West Loop and this one by far is the best!

Took my cat chase for the free coupon,would pay 300 usd for blood work i feel that the coupon was a lure no follow up on blood. Work just said he has kidney issues no guidance never saw the doctor again hopefully i shall find vets that are not on a money grab and have a passion for what they do,will never go back

Hi Katherine, thank you for sharing your rating. We’d really appreciate the chance to hear more about your experience and your visit with us. Whenever you feel ready, please reach out to us at VCAContactUs@vca.com. We’re here to listen.
They refused to see my sick cat even though I had an appointment. I am left trying to find a place that can see him and scared he won't be alright. Terrible service

Dr. Moody and his assistant were really helpful in caring for my cat. He suggested multiple treatment options and cared about her wellbeing. I've visited VCA West Loop Veterinarian many times and Dr. Moody is the best, highly recommend!

I hate that VCA is owned by Mars, however, I LOVE the staff at this location. I’ve moved away from the neighborhood and still drive 40 minutes because I find the staff to be so kind and accommodating for both myself and my very anxious dog.

Do not take your pets to this place. They give wrong diagnoses.

I lost my dog my child because of them.

They never told us that my dog had kidney problems for years. We only recently found out she had stage 4 kidney disease, when it was already too late and nothing could be done to save her.

If they had informed us from the beginning, we could have given her proper treatment and maybe had more time with her. They failed us completely.

My dog died because of VCA.
Dr. Moody saved my dog's life. We received excellent service!

I went there yesterday and was surprised by how awful they are.  My dog went in for a respiratory infection that isn’t very serious (he had the same thing last winter) and after checking him out and determining he wasn’t too sick (their words, not mine), before even prescribing medication for him which fixed the problem last year, the doctor tried to feel me out on whether I would be interested in getting him X-rays to check for pneumonia.  It was bizarre; it literally felt like she was feeling out how much money I made..  there was no medical need whatsoever to be discussing X-rays.  Also, one of the first things she said to my dog was “I bet you don’t like to be told no”  which was just passive aggressive and weird to me.  My dog also squealed in pain and ran away bc she tried to take his temperature in his anus; I’ve had dogs my entire life and I’m 41 and I’ve never had a vet do that.  Anyways, wont be going back.

Dr. Moodie has gone above and beyond for my cat on multiple occasions. He is exceptionally knowledgeable, compassionate, and truly invested in his work. Whether for routine care or unexpected emergencies, he has always been responsive, thorough, and reassuring. I have complete trust in his judgment. I am so grateful to have a veterinarian who consistently provides such outstanding care. Highly recommend!

I found the customer service and attitude of the vets to be fine, but the price is not reasonable here. Besides expensive regular check ups, they recommended dental work for our cat and quoted almost $2,000! Another vet in the city just recommended we brush our cat's teeth at home; we saw improvement and by avoiding VCA Animal Care we not only saved $2k but avoided an unnecessary, invasive, and stressful procedure on our kitty. 10 months later and kitty is fine with no dental issues...

Under the care of Dr. Aguilaur, my dog is dead. Obie Juan was her patient of many years.

I called because he had a massive infection. She was there but would not get on the phone. She said through the receptionist to give him prebioticts. He needed antibiotics.

I took him 2 times to another vetinarary care and then I had to put him down. A tumor had burst in his abdomen and he was bleeding internally.

VCA is a cruel money machine that doesn't really care about your pet.

Dr. Aguiar has been caring for my dog, Gino, since he was a puppy—and now at 11 years old, he’s still in the best hands. Gino is not always the easiest patient, and over the years he’s had a few random health issues, but Dr. Aguiar has always been patient, understanding, and thorough. She works seamlessly with other vets at VSC and Premier, and every time we see her, I feel like Gino is her top priority. She takes the time to answer all my questions and concerns, especially now that Gino is a senior dog, which gives me so much peace of mind.

When Dr. Aguiar was out on leave, Dr. Moodie stepped in to care for Gino. He was extremely thorough, followed up to check in on Gino, and went the extra mile to make sure he was back on track. That level of attention and follow-through means so much.

The staff at VCA is also wonderful. The hospital manager, Dawn, even went out of her way to track down Gino’s specialty food when it was out of stock, helping us keep his routine consistent. The support staff are always kind, efficient, and helpful with orders and questions.

Thank you to Dr. Aguiar, Dr. Moodie, Dawn, and the entire VCA team for treating Gino like family and giving him the best care through every stage of his life.
First time coming here- everyone was super friendly & the doctor treated my kitten beautifully & explained everything thoroughly. We will definitely be returning!
I took my cat here for his pre-travel identity declaration appointment and the VCA team was a pleasure to work with.  Excellent care, customer service and efficient processes in place. Thank you!

I brought my dog to this location for almost 10 years, always under the impression that they were doing what they could in order to help my dog and his many ailments. But when my dog really needed help, and I called them telling them that he couldn’t walk and wasn’t eating, they told me they couldn’t see him until Monday. Frustrated, I said that I could just bring him there and wait for when the vet had an opening so that he could be seen. The person I spoke to told me I should not do that, and that the vet has no obligation to see me or talk to me while I am there. I ended up having to put my dog down that day at a different location that I was totally unfamiliar with. Luckily the place I went was beyond amazing and helpful. This location then called me a couple days later to “express their sympathies”, although it felt much more they were obligated to call to tell me I was being refunded for two months of CareClub that my dog didn’t use prior to passing away. Now, almost a month later, a refund has yet to occur. Instead, I need to continue to call the place where I have some of the worst possible memories of the last day of my dog life. Looking back, the amount of money I spent here for what turned out to be completely unnecessary test, was absurd. However, what won’t we do for our pets? This location knows that, as other reviews have pointed out. I cannot express how badly I don’t want anyone else to feel like I did that day. Because when it comes to the hardest time of your pets life, you cannot relay on this place to try and help you when you really need it, regardless of how much money you’ve spent there. If I ever adopt another dog, I will do my due diligence in finding a vet that genuinely cares.

Prices are outrageous and I feel that they are constantly trying to upsell. The entire staff must be incentivized for profits or sales. Agree with the review that said they felt like they were at Disney and paid $9 for water.Feel totally …

My dogs have been clients at VCA West Loop since they were puppies and we have enjoyed five years of excellent care and outstanding customer service. VCA makes everything user friendly and take amazing care of my doggies. The Care Club package has been a great value. Would recommend VCA highly.

I had to put both my dogs down, which was a very troubling experience for me, but I personally feel That VCA helped me And both my dogs Feel comfortable and let me know that I made the right decision for both of my pets who were sick. I …

2nd update: I took my pets to another (way cheaper) clinic, and they did the vaccines in under 10 seconds in a way that did not upset my pets at all. VCA charged me over $300 and my new clinic was only $80. Pretty drastic for the same …
Dr. Wiese is AMAZING! Hands down the best appointment we’ve ever had for our extremely anxious dog.
